runs.text: Disgust is a universal human emotion. One type of disgust is called physical disgust, which protects us

runs.text: After finding out details about a stranger, we mistakenly think that they also know about us. As a result, we

area knew them.

local officers would find out about illegal activity than residents of the control areas. Even more strikingly, the
